theorems.name: Submission.ts_piece_density_blowup
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (C : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))) (F : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → Ambient n ℓ), 0 < n → (IsCompact C ∧ (∃ K : NNReal, LipschitzWith K F) ∧ (∀ w ∈ C, DifferentiableAt ℝ F w ∧ Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ F w)) ∧ ContinuousOn (fderiv ℝ F) C ∧ ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ v ∈ C, ∀ w ∈ C, c * ‖v - w‖ ≤ ‖F v - F w‖) → (∃ Γ : ℝ, ∀ x ∈ F '' C, ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → (μHE[n] : Measure (Ambient n ℓ)) (F '' C ∩ closedBall x ρ) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Γ * ρ ^ n)) ∧ ∀ w ∈ C, Tendsto (fun r : ℝ ↦ volume (C ∩ closedBall w r) / volume (closedBall w r)) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 1) → ∀ f : C_c(Ambient n ℓ, ℝ), Tendsto (fun t : ℝ ↦ (t ^ n)⁻¹ * ∫ y in F '' C, f (t⁻¹ • (y - F w)) ∂μHE[n]) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (∫ y in (LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ F w).toLinearMap : Set (Ambient n ℓ)), f y ∂μHE[n]))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
